title: An External Control Arm Study in Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer
official: A Prospective Study to Generate Precision External Controls in Advanced or Metastatic Non Small Cell Lung Cancer Patients
summary: A study to create control arms using current and future information in patients with lung cancer.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. \> 18 years of age at the time of informed consent
2. Pathologically confirmed locally advanced or metastatic NSCLC
3. ECOG Performance of less than or equal to 1 within 4 weeks prior to starting index therapy.
4. Life expectancy of more than 3 months
5. Able to understand and sign informed consent
6. Evidence of measurable disease (as assessed by the Investigator) on available imaging (e.g CT, MRI, PET)

\*see protocol for cohort specific inclusion criteria\*

Exclusion Criteria:

1. Actively on a clinical trial of an investigational agent
2. Currently receiving active systemic therapy for another malignancy
3. Eligible for treatment with curative intent

\*see protocol for cohort specific exclusion criteria\*
